import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Create Voronoi diagram, clip to bbox, and find Central's cell
# Then count educational institutions whose centroids fall in that cell

query = text("""
WITH stations AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT 
        ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(geom)) as bbox_geom
    FROM stations
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as cell_geom
    FROM stations
),
clipped_voronoi AS (
    SELECT 
        v.cell_geom,
        s.id as station_id
    FROM voronoi v
    CROSS JOIN bbox b
    JOIN stations s ON ST_DWithin(v.cell_geom, s.geom, 0.001)
    WHERE ST_Intersects(v.cell_geom, b.bbox_geom)
),
clipped_cells AS (
    SELECT 
        ST_Intersection(cv.cell_geom, b.bbox_geom) as clipped_geom,
        cv.station_id
    FROM clipped_voronoi cv
    CROSS JOIN bbox b
),
central_cell AS (
    SELECT clipped_geom as cell_geom
    FROM clipped_cells
    WHERE station_id = 16
),
educational_centroids AS (
    SELECT id, ST_Centroid(geometry) as centroid
    FROM sensitive_area
    WHERE category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as school_count
FROM educational_centroids ec
JOIN central_cell cc ON ST_Within(ec.centroid, cc.cell_geom)
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
